micah: Quick: Aurora wants a Private POC. Requirement: HSM-rooted keys + short-lived client certs from our cert-broker. Who owns onboarding?
tara: I'll take presales. Need a tight checklist and transport options so security doesn't block it.
leo: Security preference: PKCS#11 with attestation for production. For POC accept SCEP+OIDC or manual CSR only as a fallback. Must get CA chain and attestation artifact.
sasha: Ops note: they estimate ~120 qps and ~700 concurrent sessions. That points to ~3x A100-equivalents baseline; i'll confirm. Pricing: offer reduced commit for 30d POC + trial credits.
micah: Tara, can you list the exact artifacts and how they should upload them? I'll send kickoff.
tara: Checklist (short): 1) CA cert chain (PEM) 2) HSM vendor/model/firmware + PKCS#11 module path OR SCEP URL + OIDC creds 3) Key policy (non-exportable, allowed ops) 4) CSR (if manual) 5) Management plane allowlist CIDRs + bastion pubkey 6) Desired cert TTL/rotation cadence 7) SIEM endpoint for audit forwarding
leo: Add: PKCS#11 test vector (sign nonce we provide), attestation cert/quote, and SOC2 or ISO evidence if available. Also vendor firmware for FIPS checks.
tara: Transport options to propose: A) PKCS#11 over customer VPN (preferred) B) SCEP + OIDC C) encrypted upload to temp S3 presigned PUTs or scoped SFTP. Recommend A for prod, allow B/C for POC only.
leo: Include PKCS#11 sample commands for them to run on their HSM host (CSR generation):
```
pkcs11-tool --module /usr/lib/vendorpkcs11.so -l --keypairgen --key-type rsa:3072 --label aurora_key
openssl req -engine pkcs11 -keyform engine -new -key "pkcs11:object=aurora_key;type=private" -out aurora.csr -subj "/CN=aurora-client/O=Aurora"
```
sasha: We will issue back short-lived certs (24h-7d), a CRL/OCSP or API revocation endpoint, and an attestation token for the Dedicated pool. Also confirm if they allow our ephemeral CA signing for the POC.
oncall-bot: Ticket INF-6130 created: "aurora private-poc hsm onboarding & cert exchange"  assignee: tara  due: 3 business days  https://rwd.atlassian/INF-6130
micah: Timeline to customer: please provide chosen transport + artifacts within 5 business days to hit a 2-week POC start. I'll draft kickoff email with checklist and sample commands.
tara: I'll prepare the handoff email and update INF-6130 with replies.
micah: Thanks team. I'll ping once Aurora confirms S3 vs SFTP vs VPN and whether they permit ephemeral CA signing. :rocket:
